description: Get observation values for a Bundesbank dataflow (dataflow_id from bundesbank-timeseries.dataflows). key is REQUIRED and must be a fully dot-specified SDMX series key with no empty segments (from bundesbank-timeseries.structure), e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000" for the daily EUR/USD reference rate — an unscoped key would match every series in the dataflow and is rejected. Control the time range with start_period/ end_period or last_n_observations (max 100). Data: api.statistiken.bundesbank.de (Bundesbank SDMX 2.1 REST API), no auth required.

dataflow_id.description: Bundesbank dataflow id, from bundesbank-timeseries.dataflows (e.g. "BBEX3" for exchange rates).

end_period.description: End of period range, e.g. "2024" (annual) or "2024-12-31" (daily). Takes precedence over last_n_observations when set.

key.description: REQUIRED fully dot-specified SDMX series key in dimension position order, from bundesbank-timeseries.structure (e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000" for the daily EUR/USD reference rate on the BBEX3 dataflow: FREQ=D, CURRENCY=USD, PARTNER_CURRENCY=EUR, SERIES_TYPE=BB, RATE_TYPE=AC, SUFFIX=000). Every position must be filled — an unscoped/wildcard key would match every series in the dataflow and is rejected.

last_n_observations.description: Return only the most recent N observations (max 100, default 30). Ignored if start_period or end_period is set.

start_period.description: Start of period range, e.g. "2020" (annual) or "2020-01-01" (daily). Takes precedence over last_n_observations when set.

name: bundesbank-timeseries.series.data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Bundesbank Dataflow Data
